# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]

protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.

honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.

countries and additionally two regions.

showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

## Medix Biochemica expands its infectious diseases antibody offering through the acquisition of
## ViroStat

Medix Biochemica has acquired the US-based ViroStat LLC, a global leader in infectious disease
antibodies and antigens used by in vitro diagnostics (“IVD”) manufacturers.

[ View Details ][64]

#### Antigens, Proteins and Enzymes

We specialize in the manufacture of highly purified native animal and human enzymes and related
proteins used as critical raw materials for use in clinical diagnostics manufacturing, analytical
research, antibody production, molecular biology, cell culture and drug discovery among others.
[View Details][65]

#### Human Biologicals

Using advance techniques in collection, preservation and storage, our high quality biological
samples and specimens play a vital role in research, development and manufacturing.
[View Details][66]

#### Reagents, Chemicals and Solutions

Our high purity products are used as critical raw materials in biopharmaceutical, cell culture
media, clinical diagnostic manufacturing and life science research applications worldwide.
[View Details][67]

#### Antibodies

Our affinity purified antibodies are generated and produced with high specificity and reactivity for
use in labeling and immobilizations for ELISAs, Western blotting, RIA and immunohistochemistry
applications worldwide.
[View Details][68]

# A Global Leader in Biologicals Manufacturing in the Heart of the United States

We have been recognized by researchers and academics as a global leader in biologicals
manufacturing. With over 40 years of experience, we’ve been able to help our clients solve complex
problems - by producing and manufacturing high quality proteins and enzymes for a wide range of life
science research and diagnostic applications through novel extraction methodologies and classical
chromatography techniques.

Beyond protein and enzyme manufacturing, we distribute biological samples and specimens that often
play a vital role in research, development and manufacturing processes.

## Critical Raw Material Manufacturer

Lee Biosolutions is an ISO 13485-certified global leader in the manufacturing of critical raw
materials for the in vitro diagnostic market, supplying high purity antigens, proteins, enzymes,
antibodies, biochemicals and biologicals worldwide.

Lee Biosolutions is committed to supporting research efforts and innovation by offering a special
discount to academic researchers and institutions. Click to save!

[ View Details ][62]

## Featured Product: Myoglobin

Lee Bio manufactures Myoglobin antigens and antibodies for use in research and in vitro diagnostics
manufacturing. Shop and order online today for your immediate requirement.

[ View Details ][63]

## Medix Biochemica expands its infectious diseases antibody offering through the acquisition of
## ViroStat

Medix Biochemica has acquired the US-based ViroStat LLC, a global leader in infectious disease
antibodies and antigens used by in vitro diagnostics (“IVD”) manufacturers.

[ View Details ][64]

#### Antigens, Proteins and Enzymes

We specialize in the manufacture of highly purified native animal and human enzymes and related
proteins used as critical raw materials for use in clinical diagnostics manufacturing, analytical
research, antibody production, molecular biology, cell culture and drug discovery among others.
[View Details][65]

#### Human Biologicals

Using advance techniques in collection, preservation and storage, our high quality biological
samples and specimens play a vital role in research, development and manufacturing.
[View Details][66]

#### Reagents, Chemicals and Solutions

Our high purity products are used as critical raw materials in biopharmaceutical, cell culture
media, clinical diagnostic manufacturing and life science research applications worldwide.
[View Details][67]

#### Antibodies

Our affinity purified antibodies are generated and produced with high specificity and reactivity for
use in labeling and immobilizations for ELISAs, Western blotting, RIA and immunohistochemistry
applications worldwide.
[View Details][68]

# A Global Leader in Biologicals Manufacturing in the Heart of the United States

We have been recognized by researchers and academics as a global leader in biologicals
manufacturing. With over 40 years of experience, we’ve been able to help our clients solve complex
problems - by producing and manufacturing high quality proteins and enzymes for a wide range of life
science research and diagnostic applications through novel extraction methodologies and classical
chromatography techniques.

Beyond protein and enzyme manufacturing, we distribute biological samples and specimens that often
play a vital role in research, development and manufacturing processes.

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### With over 100 years of dosage expertise, we help our customers configure a wide variety of
#### capsule solutions to meet many common applications

#### ~120 patent families including more than 40 ingredient and over 80 capsule and dosage form
#### patent families, helping brands stand out

#### 7,000+ customers around the world leverage our comprehensive products and services, enabling
#### hundreds of millions of patients and consumers to live more active, healthier lives
* About Capsules & Health Ingredients
* Highlights in our history
* Markets we serve
* Global network
* Sustainability

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### capsule solutions to meet many common applications

#### ~120 patent families including more than 40 ingredient and over 80 capsule and dosage form

#### 7,000+ customers around the world leverage our comprehensive products and services, enabling

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

I'm developing a novel tyrosine kinase inhibitor for EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. The API
is classified as BCS Class II with very poor aqueous solubility (8.5 µg/mL) but high permeability.
Our current capsule formulation shows highly variable bioavailability and significant food effects
in Phase I trials. I need to explore advanced formulation strategies that can improve dissolution
rate, reduce fed/fasted variability, and enable consistent systemic exposure at the 150 mg daily
dose.

Specialist agents thread through every stage where formulation, CMC, and regulatory work compounds,
from preclinical development to commercial lifecycle. One co-scientist across the pipeline that
takes your molecule to market.

DeepC reads the same authoritative corpora your QPs and reviewers cite, surfaced through specialist
agents that know which source to query. Every claim links back to its primary record.

## Where every answer comes from.

Grounded in your private corpus, computed against measurable physics, verified by Reality Anchor,
our published refutation-aware framework. Every claim earns its way out before it leaves DeepC.

## We know your IP is everything.
## So is keeping it yours.

Single-tenant VPC, customer-managed encryption, 21 CFR Part 11-aligned audit log. Your data is never
used to train our base models.

TKI for NSCLC - BCS Class II Solubility
Share

I'm developing a novel tyrosine kinase inhibitor for EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer. The API
is classified as BCS Class II with very poor aqueous solubility (8.5 µg/mL) but high permeability.
Our current capsule formulation shows highly variable bioavailability and significant food effects
in Phase I trials. I need to explore advanced formulation strategies that can improve dissolution
rate, reduce fed/fasted variability, and enable consistent systemic exposure at the 150 mg daily
dose.

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

[
[default-logo]
][69]

Evologics is a biologics company committed to improving lives. Our culture places people, first –
from patients to doctors to our team.

Our mission is to make lives better through biologics products with the goal to help people to live
longer, healthier lives.

Copyright © 2026 E

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

[
[default-logo]
][69]

Evologics is a biologics company committed to improving lives. Our culture places people, first –
from patients to doctors to our team.

Our mission is to make lives better through biologics products with the goal to help people to live
longer, healthier lives.

Copyright © 2026 E

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads

## Global Market Transformation

In a recent feature published by ODT Magazine, Husnu Ceylan shared his perspective on the
transformation of the global orthobiologics market and the increasingly strategic role these
solutions play in modern orthopedic care. During the interview, Ceylan highlighted that market
growth is being driven by a convergence of demographic, clinical, and structural factors, but most
importantly by a shift in surgical thinking. Today, surgeons are not only focused on mechanical
stabilization, but are increasingly seeking biological solutions that enhance healing, improve
functional outcomes, and deliver greater long-term clinical predictability. As Ceylan noted, the
growth of orthobiologics is not simply about increasing procedure volumes, but about the evolution
of surgical care itself, where biology is becoming an essential component of standard orthopedic and
spine treatment. The feature also underscores how orthobiologics have evolved beyond a niche segment
to become increasingly integrated across spine, trauma, sports medicine, and complex reconstruction
procedures, reinforcing their role as one of the fastest-evolving areas in musculoskeletal care.

Home: About the Company

# Who We Are

At Med-X Surgical Distribution, our vision is to revolutionize healthcare by providing comprehensive
high-quality medical solutions that enhance patient care and support healthcare professionals.

Founded in 2015, Med-X Surgical Distribution began as a specialized distributor of spinal and
cranial implants and biologics. Recognizing the evolving needs of the healthcare industry, we
expanded our offerings to include a wide range of medical and surgical disposables. Our commitment
to quality and compliance led us to become FDA-registered and an approved U.S. government vendor,
enabling us to serve various government and healthcare agencies with reliable medical supplies.

At Med-X Surgical Distribution, we take pride in offering a comprehensive and diverse product
portfolio designed to meet the ever-evolving needs of healthcare providers. While our company has
significantly expanded over the years, we remain firmly rooted as one of the leading distributors of
spinal and cranial implants as well as biologics, proudly representing over 25 world-renowned
manufacturers worldwide.
In addition to our core expertise in spinal and cranial implants and biologics, we have broadened
our offerings to include our own proprietary line of surgical instruments and retractors, adult
incontinence care products, medical and surgical disposables, advanced wound care solutions, and

health care initiatives falling under the topic areas of Combat Casualty Care, Military Operational

conference

### Military Health System Research Symposium (MHSRS) Conference 2026

MTEC will be attending MHSRS! This is the premier military or civilian meeting that focuses
specifically on the unique medical needs of the Warfighter. The event provides a collaborative
setting for the exchange of information between military providers with deployment experience,
research and academic scientists, international partners, and industry on research and related
health care initiatives falling under the topic areas of Combat Casualty Care, Military Operational
Medicine, Clinical and Rehabilitative Medicine, Information Sciences, Military Infectious Diseases,
and the Radiation Health Effects. Learn more at https://www.mhsrs.net/

August 3, 2026

conference

Pour: Start-Up Competition & Happy Hour—a high-energy platform for early-stage companies innovating
in military health.

October 18, 2026

### 10th Annual MTEC Membership Meeting

We’re excited to invite you to register for a milestone event—the 10th Annual MTEC Membership
Meeting! This year celebrates a decade of collaboration, innovation, and partnership with our
Government partners and the broader MTEC community. Over two dynamic days, attendees will engage in
networking, knowledge sharing, and strategic discussions that advance military medical innovation.
This is your opportunity to connect directly with industry peers, government stakeholders, and
academic leaders shaping the future of medical technology. Please note: Registration is open to MTEC
members only. Membership is required to attend this event and participate fully in consortium
programs.

June 16, 2026

[ ORAL DELIVERY OF MACROMOLECULES: CHALLENGES AND OPPORTUNITIES FOR DEVICE-ENABLED GI DELIVERY ][83]
[ Dr Sahab Babaee discusses the potential of device-based approaches to enable the delivery of
macromolecules via the gastrointestinal tract, considering the constraints and possibilities of
mucosal delivery devices, as well as the technologies currently being investigated to make this
potential a reality. ][84]
[ [INTELLIGENT INTEGRATION: WHY CONNECTED OSD ECOSYSTEMS ARE RESHAPING PHARMACEUTICAL MANUFACTURING]
][85]
[ GI/ORAL ][86]
[ Borja Guerra ][87]
[ACG][88]
[ INTELLIGENT INTEGRATION: WHY CONNECTED OSD ECOSYSTEMS ARE RESHAPING PHARMACEUTICAL MANUFACTURING
][89]
[ Borja Guerra delves into how the oral solid dosage manufacturing industry is being reshaped by
connected machinery, advanced digital systems and integrated supplier ecosystems across the
production process. ][90]
[ [Interview: Celebrating 10 Years of Molly Enabling Patients’ Independence] ][91]
[ INTERVIEW ][92]
[ Nicholas Heaton ][93]
[SHL Medical][94]
[ Interview: Celebrating 10 Years of Molly Enabling Patients’ Independence ][95]
[ Nicholas Heaton looks back on the decade since Molly – SHL Medical’s signature two-step
autoinjector platform – was launched onto the market, reviewing what made the device platform a
success, where Molly is positioned in the market today and how it will continue to evolve to meet
the demands of the future. ][96]
[ [Interview: GLP-1 Demand and the New Reality of Device Manufacturing Capacity] ][97]
[ INTERVIEW ][98]
[ Andy Wertheim ][99]
[Quvara Medical][100]
[ Interview: GLP-1 Demand and the New Reality of Device Manufacturing Capacity ][101]
[ Andy Wertheim discusses the growing shortage of available manufacturing capacity driven by the
boom in GLP-1 therapies, why this means mid-volume development programmes across a range of sectors
are struggling to move from development to industrialisation, and how Quvara Medical is ideally
positioned to provide the capacity that these programmes lack. ][102]
[ [CLOSING THE SAFETY GAP: WHY PHARMA-DEDICATED LABELS MATTER] ][103]
[ INDUSTRIALISATION ][104]
[ Paavo Sillanpää ][105]
[UPM Adhesive Materials][106]
[ CLOSING THE SAFETY GAP: WHY PHARMA-DEDICATED LABELS MATTER ][107]
[ Paavo Sillanpää discusses why pharma-dedicated labels matter for more challenging labelling
applications as well as how to avoid potential label failure and brand risk. ][108]
[ [ADVANCING AUTOINJECTOR PLATFORMS FOR EVOLVING DRUG AND PATIENT NEEDS] ][109]
[ INJECTION ][110]
[ Martin Høier Thomsen ][111]
[MGS Mfg Group][112]
[ ADVANCING AUTOINJECTOR PLATFORMS FOR EVOLVING DRUG AND PATIENT NEEDS ][113]
[ Martin Høier Thomsen introduces MGS’s A.i.r. Platform™ within the broader context of the evolution
of autoinjector platforms towards more adaptable, customisable solutions. He considers how
next-generation autoinjector platforms can address increasingly complex and changing demands, while
helping to mitigate risk and prioritise usability. ][114]
[ [DELIVERABILITY, ACCEPTABILITY, AVAILABILITY: ASSESSING THE EVOLVING STRENGTHS OF
MICRONEEDLE-BASED DRUG DELIVERY] ][115]
[ MICRONEEDLES ][116]
[ May Pidding ][117]
[LTS][118]
[ DELIVERABILITY, ACCEPTABILITY, AVAILABILITY: ASSESSING THE EVOLVING STRENGTHS OF MICRONEEDLE-BASED
DRUG DELIVERY ][119]
[ Dr May Pidding  explores the growth and future potential of microneedle technology and its
suitability for a broad range of drug delivery applications, specifically presenting the case for
the accelerated uptake and wider adoption of Microneedle Array Patch (MAP) technology. ][120]
[ [IMPORTANCE OF BEING PATIENT-CENTRIC IN CARDIOVASCULAR-KIDNEY-METABOLIC CARE] ][121]
[ INJECTION ][122]
[ Cecile Gross ][123]
[Nemera][124]
[ IMPORTANCE OF BEING PATIENT-CENTRIC IN CARDIOVASCULAR-KIDNEY-METABOLIC CARE ][125]
[ Cécile Gross and Mark Tunkel discuss Nemera's substantial portfolio of user-friendly, effective
injectable devices available to meet the needs of patients with diverse chronic conditions. ][126]
[ [DEORA™: FILLING THE GAP FOR MULTI-USE, FIXED-DOSE INJECTION SOLUTIONS] ][127]
[ INJECTION ][128]
[ Manuela Giacon ][129]
[Stevanato Group][130]
[ DEORA™: FILLING THE GAP FOR MULTI-USE, FIXED-DOSE INJECTION SOLUTIONS ][131]
[ Manuela Giacon explores the evolution of handheld drug delivery devices, leading up to today’s
challenges, and presents the company’s latest addition to its drug delivery portfolio. ][132]
[ [LVSC DELIVERY: HOW VOLUME AND CONCENTRATION REQUIREMENTS ARE RESHAPING DEVICE SELECTION] ][133]
[ WEARABLES ][134]
[ Tony Bedford ][135]
[Phillips Medisize][136]
[ LVSC DELIVERY: HOW VOLUME AND CONCENTRATION REQUIREMENTS ARE RESHAPING DEVICE SELECTION ][137]
[ Tony Bedford considers how the rise in biologic formulations together with a strong shift towards
subcutaneous administration is shaping the drug delivery industry, particularly in relation to
large-volume subcutaneous delivery. ][138]
[ [AUTOINJECTOR TECHNOLOGY FOR AUTOMATIC MICROPARTICLE SUSPENSION AND INJECTION] ][139]
[ INJECTION ][140]
[ Girum Yemane-Tekeste ][141]
[Kindeva][142]
[ AUTOINJECTOR TECHNOLOGY FOR AUTOMATIC MICROPARTICLE SUSPENSION AND INJECTION ][143]
[ Girum Yemane-Tekeste and Stephen Leslie share how Kindeva is building on its experience and
history of innovation to develop an enabling technology for injectable microparticles and then
evaluating it through proof-of-principle testing. ][144]
[ [EARLY DECISIONS, FASTER LAUNCH: OPTIMISING COMBINATION PRODUCT COMMERCIALISATION] ][145]
[ INJECTION ][146]
[ Bill Welch ][147]
[PCI Pharma Services][148]
[ EARLY DECISIONS, FASTER LAUNCH: OPTIMISING COMBINATION PRODUCT COMMERCIALISATION ][149]
[ Bill Welch explores how early development selections, structured timelines and adoption of a “path
of least resistance” can reduce technical, regulatory and commercial risk, thereby optimising
product commercialisation. ][150]
[ [INJECTABLE COLLAGEN – PRESENT AND FUTURE POTENTIAL] ][151]
[ INJECTION ][152]
[ Martin Junginger ][153]
[GELITA][154]
[ INJECTABLE COLLAGEN – PRESENT AND FUTURE POTENTIAL ][155]
[ Martin Junginger discusses the advantages and challenges of delivering collagen via injection,
considering the role that collagen plays in the current healthcare landscape, including GELITA's
VACCIPRO^{®} and MEDELLAPRO^{®} collagen grades, and sharing insights on how that role may grow and
adapt going forwards. ][156]
[ [EXCIPIENT LANDSCAPES: HIGH-THROUGHPUT SCREENING TO SOLVE VISCOSITY BOTTLENECKS FOR BIOLOGIC
THERAPEUTICS] ][157]
[ EARLY INSIGHT ][158]
[ Dr Scott Compel ][159]
[AEMS Corp][160]
[ EXCIPIENT LANDSCAPES: HIGH-THROUGHPUT SCREENING TO SOLVE VISCOSITY BOTTLENECKS FOR BIOLOGIC
THERAPEUTICS ][161]
[ Dr Scott Compel and Dr Alex Hendricks discuss AEMS Corp's automated, microscale screening platform
that enables viscosity reduction, using innovative approaches to test excipient combinations
effectively. ][162]
[ [SCALING RADIOLIGAND THERAPY: WHY PACKAGING AND DELIVERY SYSTEMS MUST EVOLVE] ][163]
[ EARLY INSIGHT ][164]
[ Dr Eva Littringer ][165]
[Oncofuse][166]
[ SCALING RADIOLIGAND THERAPY: WHY PACKAGING AND DELIVERY SYSTEMS MUST EVOLVE ][167]
[ Dr Eva Littringer and Dr Roland Starlinger discuss the exciting new frontier of radioligand
therapy and the imminent bottleneck presented by current delivery methods running into strict limits
on handling radioactive materials. They go on to introduce the Oncofuse prefilled-syringe-based
system as a novel approach to containment and handling of these therapies, enabling radioligand
therapy to expand beyond niche specialist clinics and hospitals. ][168]
[ [CONQUERING COMPLEXITY WITH LIFECORE INJECTABLES] ][169]
[ SHOWCASE ][170]
[Lifecore Injectables][171]
[ CONQUERING COMPLEXITY WITH LIFECORE INJECTABLES ][172]
[ Lifecore Injectable, a US-based injectables CDMO, has built a reputation for embracing complex
process development and manufacturing challenges that others avoid. This mindset is rooted in the
company’s legacy as a manufacturer of sodium hyaluronate, a highly viscous material known for being
difficult to filter and fill. ][173]
[ [EXPANDING SUBCUTANEOUS DESIGN BRICK BY BRICK: THE BD NEOPAK™ GLASS PREFILLABLE SYRINGE PLATFORM]
][174]
[ PREFILLED SYRINGES ][175]
[ Hervé Soukiassian ][176]
[BD (Becton Dickinson & Company)][177]
[ EXPANDING SUBCUTANEOUS DESIGN BRICK BY BRICK: THE BD NEOPAK™ GLASS PREFILLABLE SYRINGE PLATFORM
][178]
[ Hervé Soukiassian and Sophie Lelias discuss the established injection platforms built to achieve
reliable and efficient subcutaneous delivery, going further to examine new injectable devices in
development that are designed for an optimised patient experience as well as higher-volume,
higher-viscosity delivery. ][179]

Who is Pharma Now for?
Pharma Now caters to a wide range of professionals within the pharmaceutical industry, including
C-level executives, R&D professionals, quality managers, regulatory affairs specialists, and
business leaders looking to stay informed about global trends and innovations.
How can I subscribe to Pharma Now?
You can subscribe to Pharma Now by visiting the Pharma Now website and choosing between print and
digital editions.
Can I contribute an article to Pharma Now?
Yes, Pharma Now welcomes contributions from industry experts. Contributors can submit articles,
thought leadership pieces, and case studies. You can register on the contributors' page to submit
content and gain recognition for your insights.
What advertising opportunities are available with Pharma Now?
Pharma Now offers multiple advertising packages tailored to help companies promote their products,
services, and innovations. From full-page ads to special event coverage, advertisers can reach a
targeted audience of pharma professionals. For details, visit the Advertise With Us section on the
website.

## Our Process & Procurement

[Pregnant woman icon representing perinatal tissue source for regenerative biologics.][Pregnant
woman icon representing perinatal tissue source for regenerative biologics.]

### Prescreening

Platinum Biologics products are obtained from healthy, carefully screened mothers at the time of
normal delivery. In addition to a stringent social screening interview, all mothers undergo serology
testing to ensure there is no risk for a communicable disease. No harm is brought to the mother or
her newborn and parents still have the option of storing the cord blood if desired.

[DNA helix icon representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.][DNA helix icon
representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.]

### Processing

Recovery of tissue is performed at the time of delivery by trained technicians in a sterile
environment. All processing is done in a cGMP facility following the regulations of the FDA and the
guidelines of the American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB) and the American Association of Blood
Banks (AABB).

[Validated shipping containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.][Validated shipping
containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.]

### Distribution

All Platinum Biologics products are shipped on dry ice in validated shipping containers to ensure
appropriate temperature is maintained.

[ Learn More ][16]

Platinum Biologics products are manufactured in state-of-the-art ISO Class cleanrooms. All equipment
is calibrated and validated to ensure consistent results are produced. Our facility is
FDA-registered and a multi-state licensed tissue bank providing high-quality natural biologics to
clinicians nationwide. We work closely with our partners to enhance their practice with the tools
and training necessary to implement natural biologics into their standard of care.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics is a wellness-focused company that offers nutritional supplements, biologic
formulations, and innovative health products designed to support a variety of wellness goals.
What types of products does Platinum Biologics offer?
Platinum Biologics provides dietary supplements, biologic products, wellness formulations, and
specialty health solutions featuring a range of nutritional and functional ingredients.
What are biologics?
Biologics are products derived from biological sources or developed using biological processes and
are commonly researched and utilized in health, wellness, and scientific fields.
What is the focus of Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics focuses on developing innovative wellness products that combine science-based
ingredients with modern formulation technologies.
What ingredients are commonly found in Platinum Biologics products?
Depending on the product, ingredients may include collagen, amino acids, antioxidants, botanical
extracts, peptides, vitamins, minerals, and other wellness-supporting compounds.
What is collagen and why is it important?
Collagen is a structural protein naturally present in the body that supports connective tissues,
skin, joints, and overall structural integrity.
What are antioxidants?
Antioxidants are compounds that help protect cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals and
support normal cellular function.
What role do amino acids play in wellness products?
Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins and are involved in numerous biological processes
related to metabolism, tissue maintenance, and cellular function.
Are Platinum Biologics products manufactured under quality standards?
Reputable supplement manufacturers typically follow quality control practices and manufacturing
standards to help ensure product consistency and reliability.
Who can benefit from wellness supplements?
Wellness supplements are often used by individuals seeking nutritional support, active lifestyle
products, and complementary additions to their overall health routines.
Does Platinum Biologics offer innovative delivery technologies?
Platinum Biologics products may utilize advanced formulation approaches designed to improve
convenience, ingredient stability, and product effectiveness.
Why is ingredient transparency important when choosing supplements?
Ingredient transparency helps consumers understand what is included in a product and allows them to
make informed purchasing decisions based on their wellness goals.
How can customers choose the right Platinum Biologics product?
Customers can compare ingredients, formulation types, product descriptions, wellness objectives, and
usage recommendations when selecting a product.
Where can consumers purchase Platinum Biologics products?
Consumers can browse and purchase available products directly through the Platinum Biologics website
and authorized distribution channels.
Why choose Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics offers wellness-focused formulations, science-driven product development, quality
ingredients, and a diverse portfolio of products designed to support modern health and wellness
lifestyles.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics is a wellness-focused company that offers nutritional supplements, biologic
formulations, and innovative health products designed to support a variety of wellness goals.
What types of products does Platinum Biologics offer?
Platinum Biologics provides dietary supplements, biologic products, wellness formulations, and
specialty health solutions featuring a range of nutritional and functional ingredients.
What are biologics?
Biologics are products derived from biological sources or developed using biological processes and
are commonly researched and utilized in health, wellness, and scientific fields.
What is the focus of Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics focuses on developing innovative wellness products that combine science-based
ingredients with modern formulation technologies.
What ingredients are commonly found in Platinum Biologics products?
Depending on the product, ingredients may include collagen, amino acids, antioxidants, botanical
extracts, peptides, vitamins, minerals, and other wellness-supporting compounds.
What is collagen and why is it important?
Collagen is a structural protein naturally present in the body that supports connective tissues,
skin, joints, and overall structural integrity.
What are antioxidants?
Antioxidants are compounds that help protect cells from oxidative stress caused by free radicals and
support normal cellular function.
What role do amino acids play in wellness products?
Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins and are involved in numerous biological processes
related to metabolism, tissue maintenance, and cellular function.
Are Platinum Biologics products manufactured under quality standards?
Reputable supplement manufacturers typically follow quality control practices and manufacturing
standards to help ensure product consistency and reliability.
Who can benefit from wellness supplements?
Wellness supplements are often used by individuals seeking nutritional support, active lifestyle
products, and complementary additions to their overall health routines.
Does Platinum Biologics offer innovative delivery technologies?
Platinum Biologics products may utilize advanced formulation approaches designed to improve
convenience, ingredient stability, and product effectiveness.
Why is ingredient transparency important when choosing supplements?
Ingredient transparency helps consumers understand what is included in a product and allows them to
make informed purchasing decisions based on their wellness goals.
How can customers choose the right Platinum Biologics product?
Customers can compare ingredients, formulation types, product descriptions, wellness objectives, and
usage recommendations when selecting a product.
Where can consumers purchase Platinum Biologics products?
Consumers can browse and purchase available products directly through the Platinum Biologics website
and authorized distribution channels.
Why choose Platinum Biologics?
Platinum Biologics offers wellness-focused formulations, science-driven product development, quality
ingredients, and a diverse portfolio of products designed to support modern health and wellness
lifestyles.

#### Power BI Consulting Services: What They Include and Why They Matter

Organizations across industries are investing heavily in business intelligence platforms to improve
decision-making, operational visibility, and data-driven strategy. Microsoft Power BI has emerged as
one of the most widely adopted analytics tools due to its advanced visualization capabilities and
seamless integration with modern data platforms. However, deploying Power BI alone does not
automatically create a scalable analytics environment. Professional Power BI consulting services
help organizations move beyond basic reporting by designing structured analytics systems that
integrate data sources, automate reporting processes, and deliver reliable insights for business
leaders. The Role of Power BI in a Modern Analytics Environment Power BI acts as a bridge between
complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.
However, achieving this level of integration requires careful planning, structured data models, and
ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a
Power BI Consulting Engagement A structured engagement typically begins with an assessment of
business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This
discovery phase ensures that the analytics environment aligns with business priorities rather than
simply replicating existing reports. During this stage, consulting teams also evaluate data quality,
integration requirements, and governance policies that may affect implementation. Once the
requirements are defined, consultants begin designing the architecture required to support
dashboards, automated reporting workflows, and scalable analytics models. Core Capabilities

#### Power BI Consulting Services: What They Include and Why They Matter

Organizations across industries are investing heavily in business intelligence platforms to improve
decision-making, operational visibility, and data-driven strategy. Microsoft Power BI has emerged as
one of the most widely adopted analytics tools due to its advanced visualization capabilities and
seamless integration with modern data platforms. However, deploying Power BI alone does not
automatically create a scalable analytics environment. Professional Power BI consulting services
help organizations move beyond basic reporting by designing structured analytics systems that
integrate data sources, automate reporting processes, and deliver reliable insights for business
leaders. The Role of Power BI in a Modern Analytics Environment Power BI acts as a bridge between
complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.
However, achieving this level of integration requires careful planning, structured data models, and
ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a
Power BI Consulting Engagement A structured engagement typically begins with an assessment of
business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This
discovery phase ensures that the analytics environment aligns with business priorities rather than
simply replicating existing reports. During this stage, consulting teams also evaluate data quality,
integration requirements, and governance policies that may affect implementation. Once the
requirements are defined, consultants begin designing the architecture required to support
dashboards, automated reporting workflows, and scalable analytics models. Core Capabilities
Delivered by Power BI Consulting Services Data Integration and Implementation A major component of
